title: SB Compliance Report Export
description: JSON Schema for SB bulletin compliance reports exported by ProjectAchilles (Analytics > All Executions > SB Export, GET /api/reports/sb-pc-2026-001). The format follows SB bulletin section 04: one flat row per technique/stage per endpoint. Both producers conform to this schema: the ProjectAchilles reports endpoint (primary) and the offline fallback converter f0_library/utils/sb_report.py. A report is per-bulletin: bundleId/bundleName are a single literal for the whole file and stage labels belong to that bulletin's kill chain.

organization.description: SB entity code for the reporting organization (e.g. "SB"), from the org_code parameter or the org short-name mapping.

from.description: Window start, ISO 8601 with timezone. Applied to routing.event_time (inclusive).

to.description: Window end, ISO 8601 with timezone. Applied to routing.event_time (inclusive).

executions.description: Flat rows, one per technique/stage per endpoint per run. Sorted by hostname, then timestamp, then stage. A five-stage bundle run on three hosts yields 15 rows; there is no per-host grouping level.

sourceEventId.description: Elasticsearch document _id of the bundle-control result, "<task_id>::<control_id>". Filterable in ES via an ids query or term on _id.

timestamp.description: Run completion time (routing.event_time), ISO 8601 with timezone. Per-stage timestamps are not available in the results index; all rows of one run share the run timestamp.

bundleId.description: SB bulletin identifier, a single literal for the whole report (e.g. "SB-PC-2026-001").

bundleName.description: Bulletin bundle display name (e.g. "Ransomware con doble extorsión — LockBit 3.0").

testName.description: Name of the executed test/bundle as ingested (f0rtika.test_name).

hostname.description: Endpoint hostname (routing.hostname). Coverage across the representative endpoint set is demonstrated via this field.

stage.description: Kill-chain stage number (1-5 for SB-PC-2026-001). Parsed from f0rtika.control_validator, falling back to control order within the run.

stageLabel.description: Bulletin objective label for the stage (bulletin section 02).

tactics.description: MITRE ATT&CK tactic IDs in TA-code form (e.g. TA0002).

outcome.description: Stage outcome. Mapping: exit 126/105/127 -> PREVENTED; exit 101/0 + Defender detection -> DETECTED; exit 101/0 on exfiltration/impact tactics -> EXPOSED; exit 101/0 otherwise -> MISSED; skipped control -> NOT_RUN (never emitted server-side: skipped controls are not ingested); exit 999/inconclusive 200/259/260/unknown -> ERROR.

isProtected.description: true iff outcome is PREVENTED or DETECTED.

preventedBy.description: Controls credited with prevention (e.g. ["Microsoft Defender for Endpoint"] when Defender telemetry confirms the block).

detectedBy.description: Controls credited with detection, data-driven from Defender integration fields (f0rtika.defender_detected / defender_stage_detected).

evidenceRef.description: Export-time composite, not a stored ES field: "<_id> (<error name>)" or "<_id> (inconclusive: <error name>)". The id part is the ES document _id (see sourceEventId); the suffix is display text derived from event.ERROR.
